builds.title: Standard Druid Healer
builds.notes:
:druid: Standard Druid Healer Support


### Guild Wars 2: WvW Druid Class Guide

Druids are superb healers and cleansers, providing essential boons like Fury and Protection. They offer massive burst healing but have a **medium/high difficulty** curve due to ground targets, positioning, and combo requirements.

### Gear & Build Flexibility

* **Armor:** Exotic gear is perfectly fine for WvW (purchasable with WvW currency).
* **Runes:** **Superior Rune of the Water** (Cheaper alternative to Monk runes and can be crafted).
* **Relic:** Your relic heals allies (not you) on blast finishers. *Note: A minor trait will heal you whenever you heal allies.*


### Essential Target Settings

1. **Turn OFF Autotargeting** in your game settings.
2. Create keybinds for **"Select Personal Target"** and **"Call Personal Target"**. Mark an ally in your party with this.
3. Use this to quickly target/find your ally if they get in trouble.


### Celestial Avatar (CA) Mechanics

CA is your elite mechanic (the light-blue sphere/bar above your health). It runs on **Astral Force (AF)**, generated by damaging enemies and healing allies.

* **Entering CA:** Can only enter when AF is full. Entering triggers an area condition cleanse and counts as a weapon swap.
* **The Timer:** You have 15 seconds in CA. You can spam skills (especially Skill 1, a ground-target heal) during this time.
* **Leaving CA:** Exiting puts CA on a 10s cooldown (reduced by traits/Alacrity). You can leave early, but you will lose half of your remaining AF.


### Weapon Skill Priorities

**Quick Draw Trait:** Your first weapon skill used after swapping weapons (or entering/exiting CA) gets a **66% cooldown reduction**.

1. **Celestial Avatar:** Enter a few seconds into combat. Stay in as long as possible.
* **Combo:**  Skills 4 + 3 + 2 -> Press 1 & 4 on cool down. (if you spam 1 too much you may not get a third CA 4)


2. **Staff:** Swap to Staff and immediately use **Staff 3** at your feet (preferably into a water/light field). Use **Staff 4** on enemies, **Staff 5** ahead of group movement (blast it with Staff 3 if possible), and **Staff 2** at your feet.
3. **Mace / Warhorn:** Use **Warhorn 5** before combat for pre-boons. In combat, use **Warhorn 5** (or **Mace 3** if safe) immediately after swapping, followed by **Mace 2**, **Mace 3**, and **Warhorn 4** for extra cleansing.


### Utility & Spirit Priorities

* **Utility Glyphs:** Only use these *inside* CA for heals/cleanses. **Exception:** *Glyph of Equality* is a group stunbreak; use it anytime it's needed. Stick close to your tag, as glyphs only affect nearby allies.
* **Heal Skill:** Use outside of CA to cleanse/heal. Blast its water field if you can.
* **Frost Spirit:** Strong double-cleanse and boon producer. Cast on engage in front of the group so they walk into it. Use on cooldown outside CA.
* **Nature Spirit:** Massive double-revive with a long cooldown. Use when teammates are downed or you desperately need condition clears. (Very slow 3-second cast time; easily interrupted).


### Optional Flex Slots (Replacing Glyph of Alignment)

* **Stone Spirit:** Provides Aegis, Protection, and a double blast finisher. (Highly recommended).
* **Signet of Renewal:** Bring this if facing extremely condition-heavy enemy comps.
* **Protect Me:** Less optimal, but an easy panic button requiring less thought.
* **Glyph of the Stars (Elite alternative to Nature Spirit):** Excellent flexibility. Outside CA, it provides Stability, cleanses, and a water field. Inside CA, it boosts healing and boons.


### Pets

* **Pet 1:** **Brown Bear** (Always best for WvW).
* **Pet 2 (Flex):** * *River Otter:* Extra Fury, healing, and enemy Weakness debuffs.
* *Pink Moa:* Good budget choice if you lack the Otter.
* *Siege Turtle:*  instant cast Protection and Projectile absorb
* *Smokescale:* Great for dropping a smoke field.
* *Fernhound:* Decent synergy with minor healing and Regen.
* *White Moa:* Provides Frost Aura for damage reduction.


### Critical Positioning & Micro-Tips

* **Staff 3 Warning:** If there is skill lag while you are exiting CA, spamming Staff 3 can accidentally "yeet" you wildly out of position. Be conscious of your AF bar.
* **Easy Blast Finishers:** Warhorn 5, Mace 3, Staff 3, CA 3.
* **Mace 3 Trick:** *Oaken Cudgel (Mace 3)* is a blast finisher but leaps you forward. You can **animation cancel the movement by pressing weapon swap**, dropping the blast perfectly at your feet.
* Weapon swapping cleanses only you, not your allies. Stick tight to your tag!


##  "Beginner" Heal Druid Rotation

**Pre-Fight**

Mace 2 > Warhorn 5 (on might call)  > Pet attack F2 > WEAPON SWAP >  Frost Spirit (placed just ahead of group timing it to cast as we engage)

**Core Rotation**

Staff 3 (on feet) > Staff 4 (towards enemy) > Staff 5 (ahead) + Staff 3 (blast) > Staff 2 (on Group)

WEAPON SWAP

Swap Warhorn >   Mace 2 > Mace 3 [SITUATIONAL] + Warhorn 4 + Warhorn 5 > Celestial Avatar

[Don't cast Mace 3 if the leap is BAD]

**Celestial Avatar Rotation **

CA 4  > CA 3 > CA 2  > CA 1 through CA 4 off cool down until astral force is consumed.
(the idea is to blast finish CA 4 with CA 3. )
Then repeat Core Rotation


**Notes**
- Other utilities and pet skills are slotted in as needed/off cooldown. See guidance above.
- *Healing increases with actions per min (APM) and prioritizing CA.*
- Ensure that all your skills should be used on the hottest zone, about half covering our squad and the other half on the enemy, to ensure constant cc and healing at the hottest area
- @[skill:12569:Spirit of Nature]  should be used in order, remember your spirit order, it should be subgroup -/minus 1. If the commander does not call for spirit, use it based on the number of clashes. i.e. on the 3rd clash, if you are spirit 3 you should be dropping your spirit
- You should always be blasting water fields with all your blast finishers to trigger @[relic:101268:Relic of Karakosa] relic

**Water Fields**
@[skill:31496:Sublime Conversion]
@[skill:32253:Rejuvenating Tides]
@[skill:12489:Healing Spring]

**Blast Finishers**
@[skill:31535:Ancestral Grace]
@[skill:12621:Call of the Wild]
@[skill:71963:Oaken Cudgel]
@[skill:32364:Lunar Impact]
@[skill:12497:Frost Spirit]
@[skill:12495:Stone Spirit]

builds.title: Spellbreaker DPS Boon Strip
builds.notes:
:spellbreaker: Spellbreaker DPS Boon Strip


 * Your main role on this build is Damage and Boon strip
 * Use your Spear to spike enemies at range
 * Strip boons when the group mele spikes the enemy
 * Use your melee weapons to finish enemies
 * Do not camp a weapons. Weapon swapping reduces your `Burst` cooldowns, gives you swiftness and boosts your damage by 10%
 * `Full Counter` (F2) is OP.  Endurance Gain, Adrenaline Restore, Grants Swiftness, Does Damage, Reduces your incoming Damage by 100%, Grants Stability, Grants evasion, Dazes enemies, Strips Boons. Please learn to us this Burst Skill it is amazing. 
* *Pro Tip* `For Full Counter to activate you must get hit and be within 300 range of the attacker. It is a MELEE burst skill!!`


**Boon Strip Skill List**
 * Break Enchantments (utility)
 * Winds of Disenchantment (elite)


**Defensive Skill List**
 * `Defiant Stance` (heal) = Convert incoming damage into healing
 * `Savage Leap` (GS 3) = Evade + Movement (Warrior's Sprint)
 * `Spear Swipe` (Spear 5) = Evade Evade


**Range Burst**
 * `Signet of Might` (utility)
 * `Disrupting Throw` (Spear 3)
 * `Spearmarshal's Support` (Spear 4)
 * `Harrier's Toss` (Spear F1)
 * `Maiming Spear` (Spear 2)
``The goal is to land as much damage in as short a time as possible, overlapping damage such as 
Spearmarshal's Support ⇒ Harrier's Toss to increase burst
If Spearmarshal's Support is on cooldown use Maiming Spear before Harrier's Toss instead``

**Melee Burst (USE `Bloodthister` for BIC Damage)**
 * `Signet of Fury` (utility)
    * If melee is hot use `Defiant Stance` (heal)
 * `Break Enchantments` (utility)
 * `Bloodthirster` (Sw F1)
 * `Full Counter` (F2)
 * `Bloodthister` (Sw  F1)
 * `Dual Strike` (Axe 4)
 * `Whirling Axe` Axe 5)

  ***Boon Strip***
 *  Land `Winds of Disenchantment` (elite) on the enemy group while your group is in range to follow up with a spike. You can do this either as your group pushes into the enemy group or as the enemy group pushes into your group. In either case it ISN'T usually a good idea to go far from your own group during the cast.
 *  You should be casting `Break Enchantments` (utility) as often as possible, ideally right before either you or your group spikes the enemy group
 * `Break Enchantments`(utility) is a great way to strip boons and proc Loss Aversion to give you enough Adrenaline for Arcing Slice or Harrier's Toss 
 * Spellbreaker as many passives and skill synergies that generate boon strip and boost damage. 
      * `Dispelling Force` (passive) when you daze an enemy with `Disrupting Throw` (Spear 3) you also strip a boon. That boon strip gives you adrenaline from the `Loss Aversion` trait. You also get 2 stacks of `Attacker's Insight` (trait) and strip up to 5 near by foes of one boon. Which gives even more `Attacker's Insight` (trait). There are more synergies at play here but you should get the idea.

builds.title: Tempest DPS
builds.notes:
:tempest: Tempest DPS

 - 18 Mighty Infusions
 - Peppercorn-Crusted Sous-Vide Steak
 - Potent Superior Sharpening Stone
 - [Game Play Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zWnYLYPWL0Q)


**Main Dmg of tempest comes from overloads.** However, Warhorn 5 "Wildfire" can splits into 4 segments and each segment can hit 5. that's 20 in a zerg fight. In combonation with firestorm and CFG; tempest provides high damage pressure to cook the bad guys. The build is easy but also high APM. Go fast!!
* start in Fire 
   * Arcane Echo (utility)
   * Warhorn 5 for fireworks (proc relic)
   * firestorm (utility): ONLY in fire element, other CDs are too long
   * overload(fire)
   * dagger 3(if safe)
   * dagger 2 (fire) can be used on off CD
* air attunement -> spam skills 3,2,3,4 for CC 
* Conjoure Fiery Greatsword (if available)
   * Fiery Greatsword 5,1,1,1,1,1....5,1
   * while in CFG and Fire or Air overload is ready you can use overload. overload has 180 range
* when CFG is on CD, use air overload or Fire - two warhorn skill 5 casts. 
*Earth attunement 
   * Ring of earth 2
* air attunement -> spam skills 3,2,3,4 for CC 
   * overload and wait till fire is up before going back to fire and doing the dmg rotation

**Notes:**
* Use only air and fire overloads as the rest are not worth it. 
* When using Fire - Warhorn skill 5, the AOE goes in the direction your charecter is facing not to your target.
* air attunement resets its cooldown after overload is completed when you crit.
* Fiery GS gives you additional +260 power, use skill 5 and auto attack off CD. 
* Fiery GS skill 1 is a projectile and can be reflected or negated buy spellbreaker bubble.

**Fighting Cloud**
* You **MUST USE** `Dagger/Warhorn` for zerg fights!!! However, you may switch to `Staff` when we are fighting 100% cloud opponents. 
* Don't make me police your weapon swapping. You **MUST USE** `Dagger/Warhorn` for zerg fights!!!
* Create a second Gear template so you can quickly swap back to `Dagger/Warhorn`.

builds.title: Amalgam DPS
builds.notes:
:Amalgam: Amalgam DPS

 - Weapon Options Spear, Rifle
 - 18 Mighty Infusions
 - @[food:91734:Peppercorn-Crusted Sous-Vide Steak]  
 - @[utility:9443:Superior Sharpening Stone] 
 - [Game Play Video](https://youtu.be/ipybJyHJtxE)
 - 60% crit chance unbuffed  +25% Fury&Hematic Focus  +10% when inside 450 distance *95%*  +10% `if in evolve` or (+5%,+10%,+15) Heavy Metal Trait `if enemy health is low` 

*Burst Damage Skill List*
 - `Offensive Protocol: Obliterate` (F2)
 - `Offensive Protocol: Demolish` (F3)
 - `Napalm`
 - `Thunderclap`/`Devistator`/`Jump Shot`
 - Mortar kit (if slotted to fight cloud)

*Damage Modifier Skill List* 
 - `Plasmatic State`
 - `Evolve` (F5)

*Ticking Damage Skill List*
 - `Acid Bomb`(EG4)

*StunBreak*
 - `Defensive Protocol: Thorns` (F4)
 
Example Burst Hammer Rotation
 - Start on Hammer 
 - `Thunderclap`(Hammer5)
 - `Plasmatic State`(util)
 - `FluxState`(elite)
 - `Thorns(F4)` + `Obliterate`(F2) + `Demolish`(F3)
 - `Evolve`(F5)
 - `Obliterate`(F2) + `Demolish`(F3) + `Thorns`(F4)
 - Swap to Elixir Gun 
 - `Acid Bomb`(EG4) + Weapon Swap to Flamethrower (animation canceling the Leap Back)
 - Swap to Flamethrower  -> `Flame Blast`(FT2) -> `Napalm`(FT5)  
 - Flamethrower/auto(1) -> `Flame Blast`(FT2) until Protocols are off cool down. Then Swap to Hammer and repeat(evolve wont be up yet so you only get to hit F4+F2+F3 once on the second pass)

Example Burst Spear Rotation
 - Start on Flamethrower
 - `Plasmatic State`(util)
 - `FluxState`(elite)
 - `Thorns`(F4) + `Obliterate`(F2) + `Demolish`(F3)
 - `Evolve`(F5)
 - `Obliterate`(F2) + `Demolish`(F3) + `Thorns`(F4)
 - Swap to Elixir Gun 
 - `Acid Bomb`(EG4) + Weapon Swap to Spear (animation  canceling the Leap Back)
 - Swap to Spear
 - `Roiling Skys`(Spear4) 
 - `Devastator`(Spear5)
 - Swap to Flamethrower  -> `Flame Blast`(FT2) -> `Napalm`(FT5)  
 - Flamethrower/auto(1) -> `Flame Blast`(FT2) until Protocols are off cool down. Then repeat(evolve wont be up yet so you only get to hit F4+F2+3 once on the second pass)

Example Burst Rifle Rotation
 - Start on Rifle 
 - `Plasmatic State`(util) 
 - `FluxState`(elite)
 - `Jump Shot`(Rifle5) 
 - Swap to Elixir Gun 
 - `Acid Bomb`(EG4) + Weapon Swap to Spear (animation canceling the Leap Back)
 - Swap to Rifle
 - `Blunderbuss`(Rifle2) 
 - `Thorns`(F4) + `Obliterate`(F2) + `Demolish`(F3)
 - `Evolve`(F5)
 - `Obliterate`(F2) + `Demolish`(F3) + `Thorns`(F4)
 - Swap to Flamethrower  -> `Flame Blast`(FT2) -> `Napalm`(FT5)   
 - Flamethrower/auto(1) -> `Flame Blast`(FT2) until Protocols are off cool down. Then repeat(evolve wont be up yet so you only get to hit F4+F2+3 once on the second pass)

*Build Options*
 - Weapon Options Hammer, Spear, Rifle
 - If we are fighting Cloud then Swap your (elite skill to  `Mortar Kit`), (Elixir Gun to `Gaseous State`)
 - Remember to Swap your skills and elite back to the default build when we fight organized groups.  
 - Hammer build is easier to stay on tag with and stay alive.

builds.title: Firebrand Main Stabs
builds.notes:
:firebrand: Firebrand Main Stabs

- [Video 1 - for play style not build](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3qN9pGJzrEI&t)
- [Video 2 - for play style not build](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EZrGsQpB7ak)
 - Builds focus is Stabs, Resistance, Might
 - **Stab (Top Priority)**
    - *Skills*
        - Stand Your Ground (SYG)
    - Entering Tome of Courage (F3 book)
        - Epilogue: Unbroken Lines (skill 5 in F3 book)
    - Mantra of Liberation (elite)
    - Hallowed Ground
    - Stab skills should be followed up with cover boons from heal skill/advance
    - Stability rotation starts with SYG, then F3 once stab is gone, then other options until SYG is available
    - Prioritize using Hallowed ground with lag or when the commander is going to stay in one place
 - **Resistance (2nd priority)**
 - *Skills*
    - Spear 5
  - Stalwart Stand (F3 skill 4)
 - *Stoic Demeanor (FB trait)*
    - Stoic Demeanor requires that we CC an enemy and has a 1 second internal cooldown
        - Skills that CC
            - Spear 5
      - Shield 5
 - **Might (3rd priority)**
    -  *Might Rotation*
        - F1 (Tome 1) -> Ashes of Just (F1 Skill 5) -> Scorched Aftermath (F1 Skill 4) -> Igniting Burst (F1 Skill 2) -> Spear 3
      - Use this when the commander calls for might stacks and during the fight when F1 is available
Some more notes:
 - you want to ideally swap to spear once F1 is ready to do your might stack after using spear 5 -> 4 -> 3 or 3 -> 4 so you keep the might high in your subgroup
 - Additional information on tomes
  - **Justice (F1)**
    - skill 3 is a pull, activating Stoic Demeanor
    - skill 5 grants extra damage and might
 - **Resolve (F2)**
    - skill 2 removes conditions
    - skill 5 converts conditions to boons and increases healing done to our party
 - **Courage (F3)**
    - skill 3 is a projectile reflect dome
    - skill 4 gives pulsing resistance
    - skill 5 gives protection and stability
 - Stab Rotations
    - SYG -> Advance! -> heals
  - F3 -> Epilogue: Unbroken Lines (Skill 5) ->  Stalwart Stand (Skill 4) -> Advance! -> heals(if available)

builds.title: Luminary Main Stabs
builds.notes:
:Luminary: Luminary Main Stabs
 - [Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tnwxyRZNQP8)
 - Spiced Pepper Creme Brulee
 - Magnanimous Maintenance Oil


**Rotation:**
 - On ~900 range, cast SYG -> F1
 - when moving towards/away from enemy blob cast Feel My Wrath! (elite skill)
 - On initial melee clash -> cast F3 -> F2 
 - Rotation during melee clash: 
   1. Enter Forge -> Forge Rotation -> exit Forge
   3. Staff 3 and 2 (if under heavy condi pressure)
   4. Swap mace/shield
   5. mace 3 -> wait for proc -> mace 2 -> shield 4
 - at this point your stabs should be used as it comes off CD (use your own judgement, don't use 2 stab skills back to back unless under heavy strips) with priority being given to F3 being used first. Remember to also use f1 and f2 off CD or as cover boons

**Forge Rotation:**
 1. Enter Forge
 2. Gleaming Blade(Skill 4) -> only if you are able to not be off tag, you can move slightly further behind tag and use it such that you would be on tag when used
 3. Luminous Staff (Skill 3) -> Restorative Glow (Skill 3)
 4. Dazzling Hammer(Skill 2) - this skill is a CC skill as well, try to use it in melee
 5. Radiant Bulwark(Skill 5) -> hold for 2s and move slightly in front of the commander since its a block skill allowing you to soak dmg for the squad -> Brilliant Slam (Skill 5)

**Notes:**
 - Prioritize Radiant Forge Rotation during clashes as forge 3 allows you to take dmg for the squad and forge 5 is blocks allowing you to soak dmg. Radiant Bulwark would be in CD sometimes so you can skip that when in forge.
 - ensure that you use all your F skills if its up before casting the radiant forge skills for more cd reduction on your F skills.
 - Staff 5 (Lines of warding) should be held for commander calls, however if the commander doesn't call for them just drop them on enemy pushed or when we are pushing on the enemy
 - your heal and f2 are able to deal massive condi cleanse so use them off cd if possible
 - shield 5 is an aoe knockback so use it when CCs are called or whenever we are in a melee clash
 - stay in mace/shield for optimal prot uptime and swap to staff when syg is ready ~3 cast of mace 3 and casting staff 3,2,5 would be better, rmb to swap to staff if commander calls for lines as well.
 - your dodges will give you alac with relic of rivers now so dodge more when you can. Staff 4 gives you and your squad endurance back as well on initial cast synergizing with the dodge but will root you. if needed to move you can cast staff 4 and then cancel the skill to move but there is still a delay when cancelling it.
 - most of your skills other than stab skills on your bar should always be in cd, including your elite skill in a fight.

builds.title: Scourge Boon Rip DPS
builds.notes:
:scourge: Scourge Boon Strip DPS 

**Your Role:** Pull, Boon Strip, and Damage Dealer

---

# **BOON RIP SKILL LIST**

* `Well of Corruption`
* `Nightfall`
* `Signet of Vampirism` + `Malicious Swarm`(Spite Trait) + `Signets of Suffering`(Spite Trait)
* `Ghastly Breach`
* `Unholy Feast`
* `Trail of Anguish`

---

# **SKILL PRIORITY**

* **Well of Corruption + Well of Suffering** * Always together, on call.
* **Ghastly Breach / Nightfall** * On call, not always together.
* **Trail of Anguish** * Do *not* use when standing still if it's not part of the "wells/bomb" call. Do *not* save for a stun break—it is one of the best boon corrupt skills in the game. Best used when moving in melee to cover more terrain.
* **Sandstorm Shroud (F5)** 
* **Unholy Feast (Axe 3)** => **Hunger Maelstrom (sword 4)** =>  **Devouring Visage (Sword 5) If axe is back off CD during the chain, Press Axe 3 always. The chain completion is not critical, **if downs, immediately** go to GS. 
* **Signet of Vampirism** * Use on cooldown. Do *not* save it for healing.
* **Manifest Sand Shade** => Other Shade skills that aren't on cooldown **(F1-F4)**
* **Spinal Shivers** => **Ghastly Claws** * Only on single targets.
* **Death Spiral**
* **Gravedigger** * This is for cleave. Once the enemy group has downs, this becomes your top priority skill.
* **Soul Grasp** * Only use if you are low on Life Force.

---

# **PLAYSTYLE & ROLE OVERVIEW**

**Power Scourge** is a utility DPS that sets up its group with heavy boon corruption.

* **The Spike:** Your highest priority is using `Well of Corruption` and `Well of Suffering` together with other Necromancers in the squad on the commander's call. This creates the window for your group to secure kills.
* **Secondary Wells:** Use `Ghastly Breach` and `Nightfall` just like wells—at the same time, and in that exact order, on the commander's call. If your commander doesn't call them, use them reactively to punish the enemy group pushing into yours.
* **Extra Damage:** Use `Manifest Sand Shade` => `Desert Shroud` to layer extra damage on top of your other group spikes.
* **Crowd Control:** Save `Grasping Darkness` to pull enemies into your group's spikes, or to catch enemies trying to kite away.
* **Weapons:** Focus on using **Axe/Sword** until you actively need `Nightfall` or `Grasping Darkness` on **Greatsword**.

---

# **SHADE MANAGEMENT (F1-F5)**

* **Maintain Presence:** Having at least **one active shade** at all times is critical. Thanks to *Blood as Sand*, this reduces your incoming damage by 7%. Do *not* spam shades; dropping them one at a time is much more efficient.
* **Double Coverage:** All shade skill effects occur on **both the shade AND you**. This allows you to place shades on the enemy's path while still guaranteeing cleanses for your immediate team.
* **Cast Time:** Shade skills are instant cast. Weave them into your rotation on cooldown while fighting.

---

# **VS CLOUD (SPREAD OUT ENEMIES)**

*Recommendations above are aimed toward traditional squad-vs-squad. If fighting clouds, adjust with the following:*

* **Shade Importance:** Shades are even more vital here. You can almost upkeep 2 shades at all times. The ability to hit multiple places at once and control chokepoints from a distance is extremely strong. Fights in SMC and Keeps are excellent for Scourge.
* **The Killer Combo:** Wells by themselves are strong, but combined with shades, they generate instant downs.
* **The Combo:** Place wells where your shades are located => hit `F2`/`F3`/`F4` (instant cast) => hit `Focus 5`. Most players without invulnerability will immediately go down.


* **Kiting Defense:** Use `Trail of Anguish` frequently when moving. It helps you, supports your teammates, and strips enemy boons. Any groups trying to pick off the tail of your squad will step right into it.

# SCRAPPER HEALS GUIDE

The Heal Scrapper is a strong healer in the current meta, offering excellent burst cleansing along with powerful healing and barrier generation.

---

## KEY CONCEPTS

The Heal Scrapper’s main purpose is to provide **Cleansing**, **Healing**, **Barrier Generation**, **Superspeed** and blasting fields to trigger Relic of Karakosa.

- Always rotate through your Shortbow skills, Kits, and Gyros. You can camp Med Kit (Skill 1 - Med Blaster) briefly ONLY while waiting for other skills to get off cooldown.
- The rotation is built around Elixir Gun (Skill 3 - Fumigate), your goal is to use Fumigate as often as possible. When swapping back to Elixir Gun, Fumigate or Super Elixir (Skill 5) should be just coming off cooldown.
- You should maintain **Superspeed** whenever possible.
  - When out of combat, **Superspeed** = **Swiftness**.
  - When in combat, **Superspeed** = 100% increase to forward movement speed.

__Combos:__
- **Shortbow** 4 > 2 > 5  when commander calls for **Might** 
- **Bulwark Gyro** as we push in, then switch to **Elixir Gun** 3 > 5 > 4 (Quickly weapon swap after using Skill 4 to cancel backward leap) as soo as we engage.
- **Med Kit** 5 > 3 > 2 > 4 *OR* **Med Kit** 3 > 5 > 2 > 4 (If ping is a problem).
- **Shortbow** 3 > 2 > 4 > 5 (Skill 2 and Skill 5 are blast finishers).

__Chain Reaction:__
The Chain Reaction mechanic is unique to the engineer's Shortbow. These are example of what you'll get when you chain react.
- Shortbow 3 > 2 (Condi Cleanse)
- Shortbow 4 > 5 (Grant Boons)

__Superspeed:__
- All Gyros
- Bandage Self (F1)
- Shortbow (Skill 5)

__Party Stability/Block Missiles:__
- Defense Field (F4)

__Personal Breaks Stun:__
- Healing Mist (F2)

---

### ADDITIONAL NOTES

- Switch to your **Main Shortbow** once you reach 25 stacks of Life on your **Stacking Shortbow**.
- **Superior Sigil of Frenzy** is an alternative option for **Superior Sigil of Renewal**.
- Be sure to use **Supply Crate** (Elite Skill) to stun enemies and blast your water fields.
- Drop **Chemical Field** (F3) to poison downed enemies.
- Use **Purge Gyro** when additional cleanse is required.
- Provide **Superspeed** to allies who fall behind.
- Elixir Gun (Skill 3 - Fumigate) cleanses you and your party!
- Put a **Personal Target** on a party or squad member to help guide your Shortbow skill placement.

builds.title: Troubadour Boon Support
builds.notes:
:Troubadour: Troubadour Boon Support

Troubadour Boon Support

* 12 concentration infusions + 6 healing infusions
* with regen active 100% boon duration
* Bowl of Fruit Salad with Mint Garnish
* Magnanimous Maintenance Oil
- [Video - for play style](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GpiGh1O5zc0)
   * [wall pull](https://youtu.be/GpiGh1O5zc0?t=1286)
   * [IoL](https://youtu.be/GpiGh1O5zc0?t=911)
### **Stability Skills** 
   - Crescendo + Bountiful Disillusionment
   - Mantra of Concentration
   - Tale of the Honorable Rogue

## *Troubadour Boon Support role* 
   - Provide Stability on your group for each push by watching party view when players have no stabs and spreading out your cooldowns 
   - Keep important boons up with Weapon Skills and Shatters + Bountiful Disillusionment
   - Heal allies with Lively Lute and Harmonious Harp
   - Use your weapon skills to keep up boons on allies and generate Notes for your Shatters
   - Always use your Shatter skills with at least 1 Note for Altered Chord
   - Make sure to always have a Note when using any Shatter to proc Altered Chord
   - You gain Notes through clone skills Journey and Blade Leap, Phantasm skills Phantasmal Sharpshooter and Echo of Memory/Deja Vu, and Mantra of Recovery via Ego Restoration

### **Damage Soaking**
     - You have multiple damage soaking abilities:
         - F4 - self Invuln
     - Tale of August Queen - party invuln
     - Sword 2 - self invuln
     - Shield 4 *2 - self block (Shield 4 has a flip skill which allows you to block more)
     - When soaking dmg, stand on tag or at most one step ahead of tag to soak the incoming dmg

###  **Stability**
   - Apply Stability before allies get caught by enemy CC
      - Enemy CC is most likely to land when they spike your group, your group is moving through theirs, or your group is moving away from theirs
      - It is better to use your Stability too early than too late
   - Avoid overlapping multiple Stability sources on your party, both your own and other players
   - Prioritize recharging Mantra of Concentration over everything other than survival if it is uncharged and off cooldown
   - Crescendo is your highest priority Stability skill due to Altered Chord lowering its cooldown
      - Make sure to always have at least 1 Note before casting your Shatter skills to meet the conditions for Altered Chord
   - Make sure Deafening Drum is playing when you cast Tale of the Honorable Rogue for the extra Note
      - Each Note extends the base 5s duration by an additional 5s, so you can glance at your notes and remaining CD on Tale of the Honorable Rogue to know when its safe to cast
   - When using Stability skills cover the application by applying other boons immediately after the cast
      - This is done because boon strips (which are the most common type of boon removal) always work on a first in, last out priority
      - This means boon strips will always remove the most recently applied boons first

### **Rotation**
    -  Charge Mantra of Concentration when you are about 900 range from the enemy
    -  On Engage: cast F1 for more heals -> F4 for invuln to soak dmg when entering melee -> F5 Crescendo for stability and quickness -> F3 for CC ->  continue with normal rotation, rifle skills etc
    -  When trying to sustain/squad is standing on clash: Swap to sword/shield -> shield 5 (for CC) -> shield 4 (blocks) -> shield 2 (invuln) -> shield 4 (flip skill for more blocks)
